activation_preconditions.description: A human owner must explicitly authorize any activation; this blueprint grants none and is prepared for review only.
Out-of-sample or forward performance evidence would be required; none exists, and V2C evaluates no strategy to create any.
Any connectivity would require a separate, out-of-scope broker/exchange integration and its own security review.
A licensing and commercial decision is an external human gate; the programme's standing posture is not_sell_ready.
A full security and legal review would be required before activation; it has not been performed.

components.role: First-gate candidate-free firewall: rejects every strategy/candidate id and admits only the all-zero cash_control target.
Signal-only shadow operations: passive as-of clock, hash-chained journal, latching kill switch, paper accounting; imports no candidate or engine.
Virtual-time qualification harness over a synthetic event stream with a fault schedule; measures offline SLOs, never a strategy.
Offline prospective-proposal lifecycle (prepared, not activated); fetches no new candles and installs no standing write workflow.
Process-isolated buyer evaluation that serves only redacted artifacts over a length-prefixed protocol; the vendor keeps the implementation.

honest_limitation: This is a blueprint, not a deployment. It documents how the offline components are organized; it activates nothing, routes no orders, opens no network egress, and grants no capability. Every activation precondition is an unmet human gate.
